en: Colorized vintage view of a harbor with piers, sailing ships, small boats and waterfront buildings. The image shows a river or canal opening into the sea, with a lighthouse or beacon on a spit of land at the right. Printed red text in multiple languages appears at the upper left, identifying the place as Windau/Wentspils and describing it as a fishing harbor.
